Scope: iOS 15 arm64 signed TrollStore-compatible IPA ONLY. Do not trigger Windows, paired Windows, or desktop releases.
Feature: iPhone controls PlayTorrio on an iPad over the same local Wi-Fi network. The iPad runs the receiver while the app is open; the iPhone connects as the remote.
Pairing: Explicit receiver enablement, fresh 6-digit PIN, transient session token, restricted LAN IPv4 addresses, incorrect PIN rate limiting, disconnect by stopping receiver.
Discovery: UDP broadcast discovery with manual iPad IP fallback if Wi-Fi blocks broadcast discovery.
Remote buttons: Up, Down, Left, Right, Select, Back, Home, Play/Pause, Seek -10s and +10s.
App integration: Focusable horizontal media rows, Continue Watching cards, optimized dock buttons, scroll-to-focused-item, active PlayerScreen playback command delegation and minimal playback status.
